1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralOppositeAngles
2 
3 /-! The two fan corners adjacent to the middle base determine the Case B cone widths. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
6 
7 open Real EuclideanGeometry
8 
9 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
10 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
11   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
12 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
13 
14 noncomputable def leftFanCorner (i : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
15   angle (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).pole (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).right (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).left +
16     angle (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).pole (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right
17 
18 noncomputable def rightFanCorner (i : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
19   angle (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).pole (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left +
20     angle (net.patch i.succ.succ).pole (net.patch i.succ.succ).left (net.patch i.succ.succ).right
21 
22 theorem leftFanCorner_pos (i : Fin 2) : 0 < net.leftFanCorner i := by
23   have noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({(net.patch i.castSucc.succ).pole, (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left,
24       (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right} : Set Plane) := by
25     have reorder : ({(net.patch i.castSucc.succ).pole, (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left,
26         (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right} : Set Plane) =
27         {(net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left, (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right, (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).pole} := by
28       ext x
29       simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
30       tauto
31     rw [reorder]
32     exact (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).fan_noncollinear
33   have positive := angle_pos_of_not_collinear noncollinear
34   have nonnegative := angle_nonneg (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).pole (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).right (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).left
35   unfold leftFanCorner
36   linarith
37 
38 theorem rightFanCorner_pos (i : Fin 2) : 0 < net.rightFanCorner i := by
39   have noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({(net.patch i.castSucc.succ).pole, (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right,
40       (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left} : Set Plane) := by
41     have reorder : ({(net.patch i.castSucc.succ).pole, (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right,
42         (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left} : Set Plane) =
43         {(net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left, (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right, (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).pole} := by
44       ext x
45       simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
46       tauto
47     rw [reorder]
48     exact (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).fan_noncollinear
49   have positive := angle_pos_of_not_collinear noncollinear
50   have nonnegative := angle_nonneg (net.patch i.succ.succ).pole (net.patch i.succ.succ).left (net.patch i.succ.succ).right
51   unfold rightFanCorner
52   linarith
53 
54 theorem left_base_angle_sum (i : Fin 2) : net.widenedLeft i + net.leftFanCorner i +
55     angle (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).left (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).right (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).apex = 2 * π := by
56   have total := net.junction_corner_sum i.castSucc
57   unfold DevelopedPatch.leftCorner DevelopedPatch.rightCorner at total
58   unfold widenedLeft leftFanCorner curvature
59   linarith
60 
61 theorem right_base_angle_sum (i : Fin 2) : net.widenedRight i + net.rightFanCorner i +
62     angle (net.patch i.succ.succ).right (net.patch i.succ.succ).left (net.patch i.succ.succ).apex = 2 * π := by
63   have total := net.junction_corner_sum i.succ
64   rw [show i.succ.castSucc = i.castSucc.succ from rfl] at total
65   unfold DevelopedPatch.leftCorner DevelopedPatch.rightCorner at total
66   unfold widenedRight rightFanCorner curvature
67   linarith
68 
69 theorem left_base_cone_bounds (i : Fin 2) :
70     π < net.widenedLeft i + net.leftFanCorner i ∧ net.widenedLeft i + net.leftFanCorner i < 2 * π := by
71   have total := net.left_base_angle_sum i
72   have positive := angle_pos_of_not_collinear (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).petal_noncollinear
73   have small := angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear (net.patch i.castSucc.castSucc).petal_noncollinear
74   constructor <;> linarith
75 
76 theorem right_base_cone_bounds (i : Fin 2) :
77     π < net.widenedRight i + net.rightFanCorner i ∧ net.widenedRight i + net.rightFanCorner i < 2 * π := by
78   have total := net.right_base_angle_sum i
79   have noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({(net.patch i.succ.succ).right, (net.patch i.succ.succ).left,
80       (net.patch i.succ.succ).apex} : Set Plane) := by
81     simpa only [Set.insert_comm] using (net.patch i.succ.succ).petal_noncollinear
82   have positive := angle_pos_of_not_collinear noncollinear
83   have small := angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear noncollinear
84   constructor <;> linarith
85 
86 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
